resources.string: Notices which app comes to the front, so focUS simulator can stand in front of the ones you chose. If you block websites, it reads your browser\'s address bar. If you lock blocking, it recognises the Settings screens that would turn it off. It stores only app and site names with times, and sends nothing anywhere.
Stops app blocking being uninstalled while its lock is on. It asks for no other powers.
